Tut.1_Desc: Welcome to Ragnaকন্ট্রোলার! This tutorial will help you get started.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-প্যাড to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. দबান 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: Casting Storm Gust has never been easier. রাখুন down your skill button (e.g., L1+A). The targeting circle appears. Aim with the right stick. Simply RELEASE the button to cast the spell!
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the ডান স্টিক slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? রেকর্ড করুন your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline সংশোধনor. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
